title: Transcript recall after compaction in Claude Code (opt-in)
description: After Claude Code compacts a session, a SessionStart hook tells Claude how to recall earlier turns by question with recall.mjs (OpenRouter rerank model, local BM25 fallback). On a 30-question benchmark over a compacted session (bench/recall), Sonnet answered correctly with half the turns, about 27% lower cost and half the median time compared with searching the transcript itself.
postInstall: Transcript recall enabled for Claude Code (SessionStart hook on compaction; the hook itself makes no network call). Each recall sends the session's turns, after secret redaction, to OpenRouter's rerank endpoint (voyageai/rerank-2.5 by default, about $0.01 per question for a long session; change with JEV_RECALL_MODEL). Use --local for BM25 only. Opt out per project with .claude/jev-off (recall then stays local), everywhere with JEV_HOOK=0. Manual use: node "<JEV_HOME>/recall.mjs" "<question>" --file <transcript.jsonl> [--project] [--k 5].
